hooks.name: team-state-session-start
hooks.description: Inject the active team run's goal and progress so a restarted session resumes instead of re-planning.

hooks.name: team-state-prompt-submit
hooks.description: Remind the agent of an active team run, with open task IDs, on every prompt.

hooks.name: team-state-dispatch-log
hooks.description: Log every subagent dispatch to .team/log.md while a team run is active.

hooks.name: team-state-completion-log
hooks.description: Log every subagent completion (with its STATUS line) to .team/log.md while a team run is active.

hooks.name: team-state-stop
hooks.description: Append a session-end summary and flag team runs that ended with open tasks.
